features.motif: Only the lawyer sets the link ontology (~/.piecemaker/ontologie.json, common to all cases), in the Index › Ontologie tab. Read it with pm okf ontologie. To propose a change, edit ontologie.json with the Edit or Write tool (or apply_patch), never with the shell: the edit becomes a proposal and the lawyer decides.

Only the lawyer sets the folder tree (.piecemaker/arborescence.json), in the Index › Classement tab. To propose a change, edit arborescence.json with the Edit or Write tool (or apply_patch), never with the shell, or run pm dossier arborescence --dossiers: the edit becomes a proposal and the lawyer decides.

Only the server writes the OKF records (.piecemaker/okf/). You can read them with Read, cat, grep or ls in a command that writes nothing. To add or remove a link, a premise or a party, use pm okf link or pm okf unlink with a relation of the ontology (pm okf ontologie). To record that a document was read and nothing justifies a link, use pm okf examinee <document> --motif "reason".

Only the lawyer sets the case steps (.piecemaker/etapes.json), on the board of the Suivi des dossiers tab. Read the current step and the document to produce with pm check. Never write this file. To change a step, ask the lawyer.

Only the PieceMaker server writes the document protection file (.piecemaker/protection.json). Only the lawyer removes the protection, with the shield of the case in the sidebar. Never write this file. Read the converted Markdown of a protected document, not the PDF or the image.

catalogue.description: Case state, document conversion, folder tree, filing and the case database: start here with check_case.
OKF index of the case documents: cited links between documents, premises, parties and the link ontology.
Tabular review: one question per column, one document per row, each answer with a verified quotation.
Exhibit list (bordereau) and stamping of the exhibits.
Legal reasoning written in .piecemaker/raisonnements/<name>.yaml and checked line by line.
Procedural events and deadlines of each act, project memories and the Matter board.
A legal rule as a Catala program, run and proved on the case premises.
Files of the case folder, Word documents first: read, draft and edit them.
